subject: Mental Models
title: The Zone of Agreement
description: Learn The Zone of Agreement in one minute.

hook.text: A buyer will pay up to $300,000. A seller will accept no less than $270,000.

buildup.text: ZOPA is the range where both parties can agree.

discovery.text: Howard Raiffa formalized ZOPA in The Art and Science of Negotiation in 1982.

twist.text: Skilled negotiators claim more of the ZOPA.

climax.text: Before negotiating, estimate their ZOPA boundary. Research their constraints, alternatives, and pressure points.

punchline.text: Know their limits better than they know yours.

quiz.question: What is ZOPA?
options: The range where both parties can agree on a deal
The optimal price in any transaction
